conventions.weights: weights_for_solver.json (claude-b), bins_k in claude-b's numpy convention; 'mirror' puts w_k on solver bin -k (claude-b's bins as claude-b applies them), 'given' on solver bin +k
conventions.F_w: Var(N_w) / sum_k w_k^2 nbar_k; Var from the discrete RK4IP adjoint (input vacuum); F_R = Raman Langevin variance (coth 300 K, trapezoid in z) / sum_k w_k^2 nbar_k
conventions.bandwidth_ratio: var_in/var_out of the photon-number spectra over the whole grid, Omega T0 units, each about its own photon-weighted mean
conventions.case1: Kerr only, T0 = 1 ps, beta2 = 1 ps^2/m, gamma = 1/W/m, omega0 T0 = 1e9 (s = 1e-9), Nt 512, 4000 steps
conventions.case2a: physical fibre, self-steepening suppressed (omega0 T0 = 1e6, as B_noss), no Raman, Nt 512; photons counted uniformly at hbar*omega0(1550 nm)
conventions.case2b: physical fibre, self-steepening suppressed (omega0 T0 = 1e9), AgarwalRaman, Nt 2048; photons counted uniformly at hbar*omega0(1550 nm) and the reservoir prefactor hbar*omega0/gamma at 1550 nm
conventions.case2c: physical fibre, self-steepening on (1550 nm), AgarwalRaman, Nt 2048; physical photon counting 1/(hbar(omega0+Omega))
conventions.case3: as 2c at N = 20, z = 0.3 z_wb, N20_zr0.3 weights
conventions.F_R_variants: notebook = noise injected as i gamma A m; ssweight = through the solver's (1+Omega/omega0)*damped_freq_window
